See our full shop policy for details. Description The KHDK Electronics LCFR is a limited-edition overdrive/boost pedal crafted in collaboration with Nergal of Behemoth. Combining aggressive high-gain power with smooth, solo-ready tones, this pedal is ideal for both searing leads and precision-driven rhythm playing. Its classic KHDK build ensures reliability, versatility, and a professional-grade sound that will become a staple on any pedalboard. Visually striking, the LCFR features a choice between the original black-and-bronze chassis or the second edition "The Second Coming" with a white-and-bronze finish. Limited to only 333 units worldwide, it is a collector's item designed for players seeking Nergal's signature tonal aggression. With controls for Gain, Volume, Bass, Treble, and a Mid-frequency cut/boost (on the second edition), the LCFR provides complete tonal shaping for a broad spectrum of high-gain textures.
